vulnerability.title: SQL injection via string-concatenated query
vulnerability.weakness: GET /search builds SQL with f-string interpolation of user input instead of parameterized queries.
vulnerability.mitigation: Use parameterized queries / bound parameters; keep detection mode MONITOR or BLOCK; disable the lab catalog when not demonstrating.

vulnerability.title: SQLi-shaped payload in login username
vulnerability.weakness: Login accepts arbitrary username strings; detectors score the field even though MySQL auth itself is parameterized.
vulnerability.sink: POST /login (username field inspected by SQLi detector)
vulnerability.mitigation: Input validation + detector BLOCK mode; never concatenate SQL.
